topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, acknowledges the complexity of complement nomenclature, and sets the stage for the lecture.

topics.label: Complement system fundamentals and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and the pivotal role of component C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream recognition pathways and how they reach the local concentration threshold needed for C3 activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream processes by which activated complement eliminates pathogens and promotes inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host cell protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the regulatory proteins and inhibitory mechanisms that prevent complement from attacking host tissue.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease phenotypes and clinical consequences that arise from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the evolutionary strategies and molecular mechanisms used by pathogens to escape complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of upcoming topics
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the discussion on complement and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
